purpose: Define each auditable security, governance, data, configuration, policy or administrative action as explicit append-only evidence linked to exact actor, operation, target and result identities.

topics.name: Audit Event Identity
topics.purpose: Define each auditable security, governance, data, configuration, policy or administrative action as explicit append-only evidence linked to exact actor, operation, target and result identities.

semantics.identity_rule: Each machine-significant audit event has an explicit evidence identity.
semantics.operation_rule: Requested/executed operation identity is explicit where applicable.
semantics.decision_rule: Relevant authorization/governance decision refs are exact.
semantics.time_rule: Timestamp is evidence metadata, never authority or causal proof by itself.
semantics.authority_rule: Audit evidence grants no remediation or access authority.

invariants.rule: Policy, decision, evidence, audit record, consent, incident and compliance result remain separate machine-significant identities; no evidence artifact silently becomes source data, authorization or runtime authority.

Ambiguous or unresolved governance for protected data fails closed; UI visibility, transport reachability, cache presence, role title, prior access or audit-log presence never substitute for an explicit valid policy decision.

hard_gates.condition: audit event inferred from log text only

references.purpose: Audit events may reference exact authorization decisions.

prose.summary: Define each auditable security, governance, data, configuration, policy or administrative action as explicit append-only evidence linked to exact actor, operation, target and result identities.
